Game Overview

Tiki puts players into a casual experience centered on guide the adventurous Tiki across mysterious landscapes by precisely measuring bamboo lengths to safely bridge gaps. This engaging game challenges your timing and judgment as you tailor bamboo extensions to perfection, navigating Tiki through ever-evolving terrains. A captivating journey filled with both simplicity and exhilarating precision awaits.
